note: Generated by export_corpus.py from the independent model (scripts/directed-scene-proof/model.py) and exact fractions of the bundles' own fps. No destination output is stored here.

framePixel.rule: max channel delta of a rendered PNG (no codec) against the model, 8-bit sRGB, flat blocks only
framePixel.why: same tolerance as scripts/directed-scene-proof (texture filtering / sRGB round trips), used by the baseline phases

videoPixel.rule: max(|r-r'|,|g-g'|,|b-b'|) <= maxChannelDelta on every probe, decoded as BT.709 limited range
videoPixel.why: h264 crf<=18 + 4:2:0 at flat interiors; a BT.601/BT.709 mix-up moves saturated colours by >20 (negative control)

timing.frameCount: decoded frames (`-count_frames`) == requested frames, container nb_frames agrees when present
timing.fps: r_frame_rate and avg_frame_rate equal the bundle fps as an exact fraction
timing.duration: last pts + one frame period == frames * den/num within 1 ms; every pts delta is one exact frame period

identity.rule: a decoded frame is closer (mean abs probe delta) to the model's frame at the same index than to any other exported frame, applied only where the model itself keeps them apart by more than 3x maxChannelDelta

detail.rule: contrast = (mean Y of the columns that should be white - mean Y of the columns that should be black) / 255 over each stripe band of the decoded frame (1, 2 and 4 px stripes); a proxy (<= 3/4 resolution) drops 1 px contrast below 0.2

budget.rule: wall clock of the export op, SwiftShader GL, one run on an idle machine; per case in `cases`
budget.note: initial budget, not a promise of speed: the coordinator revises it explicitly, never silently

main_1080_event.covers: event channel start (12) and end (36 is outside), cycle sway, hero/echo, 1080p

main_1080_cut.covers: shot cut at 48 and the camera segment join (continuous transition), 1080p

ntsc_1080.covers: rational frame rate 30000/1001: exact fps, duration and pts spacing

detail_4k.covers: original 3840x2160 PNG at 1:1 (a proxy shows as lost 1 px stripes)

restored_1080.covers: same export after the origin folder was deleted (package restore, and managed base)

snapshot_1080.covers: scene edited while the export job runs: the file must hold the snapshot taken at start

audio_1080.covers: bundle declares a directed audio mix (440 Hz then 880 Hz): window 1.5-2.5 s mixed and verified, or refused, never dropped

detail.mapping: output pixel (x, y) = texel (x, y): plane fills the frame exactly (camera z=6, fov 40, 16:9)

audioPolicy.statement: A directed scene has no audio unless its bundle names a mix. A bundle WITHOUT `audio` must export with zero audio streams and without claiming audio. A bundle WITH `audio` must either carry that mix (audio stream whose spectrum holds the tone at the right window) or be refused with a typed error and no file. Silently dropping it, or adding an audio stream with other content, fails.
audioPolicy.explicitLimit: a successful export with no audio stream is accepted only if its result carries a warning whose code is listed in adapters.json `audio_not_mixed_warning_codes` (an explicit, typed limit)
